dataset.images: SYNTHETIC renderings of digital ECG signals
dataset.split: test (held-out PTB-XL fold 10), frozen trust model from the full run

thresholds.rule: POST-HOC (configs/analysis_addendum.json): lowest val threshold with accepted bad-beat rate <= 1%; reject: highest val threshold with rejected bad-beat rate >= 50%

rule.t_accept: lowest val threshold such that the bad-beat rate among beats scoring >= t is <= 5% (fallback: nothing accepted)
rule.t_reject: highest val threshold such that the bad-beat rate among beats scoring < t is >= 50% (fallback: nothing rejected)

hypotheses.primary_metric: AURC (mean beat error averaged over coverage; lower is better)
hypotheses.bootstrap_unit: record (all conditions of a record resampled together)

operational.kind: post-hoc operating point (configs/analysis_addendum.json), thresholds chosen on val

operational_prereg.kind: pre-registered rule (accepted bad-rate <= 5%); vacuous because the base bad-beat rate is below 5%
